policy.source: At the originally development-selected checkpoint, divide the actual canonical cached full-training acceptance loss by its actual canonical initial acceptance loss; divide the actual weighted development selection loss by its actual initial weighted development selection loss. Do not substitute independent NumPy or posthoc diagnostic reductions. Both denominators must be positive and finite; otherwise report this diagnostic unavailable/false. A5%engineering margin, not an application-adequacy cap or test-derived target. No alternate checkpoint selection. Use the current candidate own numerical objective for both ratios; do not compare raw scalar losses across arms with changed training-derived weights/scales.
